item.title: Stock Selloff Eases in Asian Trade, Crude Falls: Markets Wrap
item.description: A selloff in stocks eased during Asian trading on Monday as regional equities fell less than their Wall Street peers and US equity futures turned higher. Oil declined.

item.title: Sungrow Shares Jump on Bullish Outlook for Battery Storage
item.description: Shares in Sungrow Power Supply Co. soared after the company said income dropped but that battery storage demand was set to soar.

item.title: Millennium’s Raiskin Says Asia Markets Enjoying Regulatory Aid
item.description: Asia’s public markets are enjoying a slew of measures from regulators, offering support they haven’t had for many years, Millennium Management’s regional co-CEO Julia Raiskin said.

item.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 2
item.description: Oil declined after a report said US President Donald Trump wants to give diplomacy with Iran more time before potentially resuming strikes following Tuesday’s midterm elections.

item.title: Foreigners Make Record Withdrawal From Taiwan Stocks on AI Rout
item.description: Foreign outflows from Taiwanese stocks hit a record in October as a global selloff in artificial intelligence play pushed the island’s benchmark closer to a technical correction.
